verdict.rationale: Evidence shows an MCP server for AI assistants to query cap table data (docs-11, docs-12), but this is a narrow, purpose-built integration, not a documented general-purpose public API. Explicit probes for OpenAPI/Swagger documentation all returned 404, indicating no public API is documented. Missing for 10: any documented REST/GraphQL API, API reference docs, authentication/rate-limit details, or SDKs that would let an AI-native user drive the product generally.
